summary: Practise risk-based planning, control testing, and findings follow-up. Explore the five-day course and build audit-ready work products.
lede: Risk management for audit and compliance work helps practitioners assess exposure, test controls, and document assurance findings. Designed for internal auditors, compliance officers, and risk managers, the course covers updating risk assessments, setting likelihood and impact criteria, mapping risks to controls, prioritizing audit coverage, evaluating control design and operation, organizing evidence, and reporting findings while tracking corrective actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess organizational and compliance risks, test controls, document assurance evidence, and monitor agreed corrective actions. It suits intermediate practitioners with experience in audit, compliance, or risk processes.
modules: Global Internal Audit Standards and Risk Planning
Global Internal Audit Standards Engagement Scoping
prerequisites: Prior experience in internal audit, compliance, risk assessment, control testing, or assurance documentation is expected. Familiarity with spreadsheets and document editors will support the practical exercises. Coding is not required.
